verdict.rationale: Wise documents the banking pieces: multi-currency accounts holding up to 56 currencies, global account details, and opt-in passthrough FDIC insurance. It also documents spend pieces (debit cards with MCC- and currency-based spend controls) and outbound payments, including batch groups of up to 1000 transfers. However, nothing shows dedicated bill-pay tooling or Wise positioning itself as a consolidated replacement for separate spend, bill-pay, and banking tools, and much of the card and spend-control evidence is partner-platform API documentation rather than founder-facing features. Missing for 10: explicit bill-pay/AP features (invoice capture, approvals, scheduled bill payments), founder-facing spend management, any evidence of consolidation into one platform, and independent hands-on corroboration.
